audit_name: Phase 0: Answer-Aware Greedy Oracle Scientific Audit
verdict: Suboptimal greedy heuristic; NOT a true upper bound
failure_modes_identified: Subphrase shadowing: length-2 subphrases of frequent length-3 phrases consume slots with zero marginal utility
Self-overlap distortion: rolling counts overestimate non-overlapping tiling capacity by up to 50%
Myopic greediness: candidate selection does not condition on previously chosen phrases
Capacity waste: >50% dead slots across real text responses
